doc: Every data-fetching, client-state, cache, realtime or database library a Next.js app depends on must be listed here with its one role. A second library for an existing role is a one-off; extend the approved one or amend the ADR first.

libraries.name: drizzle-orm
libraries.role: ORM and query builder; the only way app code talks to Postgres (via @/lib/db).

libraries.name: drizzle-kit
libraries.role: Migration generation only (drizzle-kit generate). Migrations apply through apps/web/scripts/drizzle-migrate.ts on the direct endpoint; never push/migrate from drizzle-kit in CI or prod.

libraries.name: @neondatabase/serverless
libraries.role: The one driver: WebSocket Pool in lib/db/client/connection.ts (app, RLS session state); HTTP neon() only in scripts.

libraries.name: ws
libraries.role: WebSocket constructor for the Neon Pool in Node.

libraries.name: postgres
libraries.role: Test-only driver for local Postgres fixtures (tests/, *.test-utils.ts). Never imported by app code.

libraries.name: @electric-sql/pglite
libraries.role: Test-only in-process Postgres for unit tests.

libraries.name: @tanstack/react-query
libraries.role: The one client cache, only where client interactivity needs it (lib/queries).

libraries.name: @tanstack/react-query-devtools
libraries.role: Dev-only inspector for the client cache.

libraries.name: @tanstack/react-pacer
libraries.role: Client-side timing only: debounce/throttle/rate-limit of user input and autosave (lib/pacer). Not a cache, not a fetcher.

libraries.name: nuqs
libraries.role: URL search-param state (filters, tabs) through lib/nuqs.

libraries.name: @upstash/redis
libraries.role: Durable cross-instance counters, locks, rate limits and dedupe. Not a read cache for data the Next cache already holds.

libraries.name: redis
libraries.role: Local-development Redis client behind lib/redis-local-client.ts only.
